title: test-integration: 21 files with distinct, individually-unresolved failures remaining after ISS-0645's adp09/adp10 fix pass (each needs dedicated per-file root-causing)
symptom: GH-649/ISS-0645 required triaging the 26-file residual cluster left after fixing the adp0x schema-literal bug (GH-482/ISS-0150). This pass (WF03-GH649-20260810) fully fixed adp09_tamper_evident_audit_chain_test (all 4 tests, verified across 3+ independent runs) and root-caused + partially fixed adp10_agent_io_capture_audit_test (2 of 3 layers fixed; residual concurrency-related reversion tracked separately as ISS-0646). It ALSO fixed 5 of xc02_audit_immutability_test's 7 tests (the same session_replication_role and ::uuid-cast root causes as adp09, applied via the same precedented per-INSERT-scoped fix pattern already used in audit_chain_utf8_test.zig) -- but 2 of xc02's tests (TC-XC-02-01, an unrelated CONNECTION_REFUSED noise case, and the concurrency-race-affected subset) remain unresolved. The other 20 files were run individually against a freshly migrated, workspace-owned database (bpm_gh649_final) TWICE, and every one of them failed BOTH times with genuinely distinct assertion failures spanning unrelated subsystems -- confirmed NOT connection-pool/environment noise (those signatures, e.g. PgError.ServerError/readUntilReady with no assertion detail, or CONNECTION_REFUSED, were excluded from this list and left as flaky-adjacent per ISS-0645's own existing classification).

per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.db_integration_test.zig TC-DB-03-02: exited with code 3, error.Unexpected NTSTATUS=0xc0000008 (INVALID_HANDLE) -- Windows connection-handle failure inside pg.zig's extendedQuery/flush path. Environment/pool-exhaustion signature, not an assertion failure, but reproduces consistently across both final runs in this pass (unlike most connection-noise cases which are non-deterministic) -- worth a dedicated look at whether db_integration_test specifically triggers a real connection-lifecycle bug rather than pure noise.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.env01_test.zig TC-ENV-01-03: expected 0, found 51 -- 'existing tenant rows have tenant_type=production and production_tenant_id IS NULL' fails because 51 tenant rows violate this invariant. Likely shared-tenant_default-state pollution from concurrently-running sibling test binaries writing tenant rows without tenant_type set, but not yet confirmed against a controlled single-binary run.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.env02_test.zig TC-ENV-02-01: assertion failure: 'T-test connection search_path contains T-test schema and not T schema' -- search_path does not contain the expected per-test schema substring. Not yet root-caused.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.env03_test.zig TC-ENV-03-01/02/05: DebugAllocator leak of 15 allocations per test, traced into src/definition/store.zig rowToDefinitionFromFields -> promoteDefinition path. This is a genuine memory-leak signature (not flaky/environmental) and is the highest-confidence real, fixable defect in this batch -- recommend prioritizing this file first in the follow-up run.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.event_store_integration_test.zig TC-ES-0: three distinct assertion failures in one file: metadata-defaulting, tenant-scoped read isolation, and migration-provisions-tenant-columns checks. Not yet individually root-caused.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.exp201_202_entities_test.zig TC-EXP-202-: create/update/delete entity-record-projection round-trip failures. Possibly related to the entity_type_instances/entity_record_latest tenant-scope work already fixed once in GH-375/ISS-0112 (1140_iss0112_entity_tables_tenant_scope_corrective.sql) -- worth checking whether this is a residual gap in that fix or a separate regression.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.exp601_tier_quota_test.zig TC-EXP-601-04: quota middleware rejects sandbox allocation test fails with 'killIdleConnections: unexpected cross-owner idle connections remain' warning immediately preceding the failure -- likely connection-pool cross-contamination from concurrent binaries, but the test itself does assert business behaviour (not just connectivity), so not conclusively noise.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.gh512_t010_regression_test.zig TC-RG-02: SEPARATE, PRE-EXISTING issue, NOT part of this cluster's scope -- filed separately as ISS-0648 (baseline count drift 117 vs snapshot's expected 115, confirmed present on main BEFORE this WF-03 run via `git show HEAD:tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json`).
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.idn03_role_access_test.zig TC-IDN-03-03b: 'TASK_WORKER GET /tasks returns own and group-member tasks only' preceded by the same 'cross-owner idle connections remain' warning seen in exp601 -- likely connection-pool contention, needs isolated re-run to confirm.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.iss0125_cascade_test.zig TC-ISS-0125-02/: cascade-delete tests for process_definitions -> definition_snapshot and a cleanup-helper error-propagation test. Not yet root-caused; unrelated to audit chains.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.iss0602_cross_process_isolation_test.zig: 'kill predicate does not affect a differently-tagged sibling connection' -- this test explicitly exercises cross-PROCESS isolation under concurrency, so a failure here under a genuinely concurrent 40-binary run may indicate either a real defect in the isolation predicate OR the test's own expectations being sensitive to how many sibling processes are actually running at measurement time. Needs re-measurement with a controlled, known process count.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.iss0605_orphan_self_heal_test.zig TC-ISS: fails via 'verify_test_env.py --quick exited 1, expected 0' -- the test invokes the environment-health checker as part of its own assertion and got a non-zero exit under concurrent suite load. Needs the checker's own diagnostic output captured to see which of its checks failed.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.iss107_tenant_storage_mode_test.zig inse: expected LEGACY_RLS, found a different value -- storage-mode defaulting logic possibly affected by the same tenant_default concurrent-reconciliation class of issue as ISS-0646, or a genuine defaulting-logic bug. Not yet distinguished.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.iss206_token_multiset_test.zig ISS-206: 'join_counters with data round-trips correctly' -- DebugAllocator leak of 1 allocation traced through the same dupe__anon_35577 path seen in env03 (src/definition/store.zig or a shared serialization helper). Possibly the SAME underlying leak as env03's, surfacing in two different test files -- worth investigating together.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.obs03_audit_log_test.zig TC-OBS-03-INT-0: 'read-only GET/list operations do not create audit rows' (expected 200, found 500) and a pagination/filter ordering test. The 500 status suggests a genuine server-side error, not just a data-shape mismatch -- worth checking server logs/error body for the underlying exception.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.onboarding_realm_guard_test.zig TC-ISS00: expected instance status 'failed', found 'completed' -- OIDC realm-missing guard is not transitioning the instance to the expected failed state. This is a clear, well-defined business-logic assertion mismatch (not noise) and is a good second candidate (after env03's leak) for the highest-confidence fixable defect in this batch.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.sim01_04_simulation_mode_test.zig TC-SIM: 'simulation events are isolated from real tenant queries' fails via PgError.ServerError inside readUntilReady -- likely a real SQL error (not just connection noise, since a query error surfaces distinctly from a connection-refused/handle error), but the specific SQLSTATE was not captured in this pass's log level. Needs a re-run with -Dlog-pg-errors=true.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.spt01_iss0068_onboarding_schema_test.zig: expected 115, found 11 -- 'every tenant has a tenant_schemas row and tenant_default exists' count check. The large expected-vs-actual gap (115 vs 11) strongly suggests shared-state visibility differences across concurrently-provisioned tenant schemas from sibling binaries, similar to env01's 51-row violation -- both may share a root cause in how tenant_schemas rows accumulate/are counted under concurrent provisioning.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.svc04_admin_api_test.zig 'admin register: PgError.ServerError via readUntilReady, same signature class as sim01 -- needs -Dlog-pg-errors=true re-run to see the actual SQLSTATE/message.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.xc02_audit_immutability_test.zig TC-XC-0: TC-XC-02-01 fails with a distinct CONNECTION_REFUSED (pure environment noise, does not need a code fix). TC-XC-02-02/04/05/06/07 were fixed in this pass via the session_replication_role wrap (matching adp09's fix) and the bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash ::uuid->bare-TEXT cast fix (matching adp09 TC-ADP-09-05), verified passing in an isolated single-binary run, but 5 of these 6 tests are the SAME kind of trigger-function-body-dependent test as adp10's TC-ADP-10-02 and are suspected to be subject to the SAME tenant_default concurrent-reconciliation race tracked in ISS-0646 -- re-measure xc02 specifically once ISS-0646 is resolved to confirm.
per_file_evidence_from_this_pass.xc06_backwards_compatibility_test.zig TC: five distinct backwards-compatibility scenarios (schema upgrade continuity, event-type evolution, archived-event queryability, multi-step schema evolution, audit-log-evolution chain integrity) all failing via PgError.ServerError/readUntilReady. Needs -Dlog-pg-errors=true re-run per-scenario to distinguish real defects from noise.

acceptance_criteria: Each of the 20 files listed above (21 minus gh512 which is filed separately as ISS-0648) individually re-measured in true isolation (single binary, no concurrent siblings) against a freshly migrated database, with -Dlog-pg-errors=true where a PgError.ServerError signature was seen in this pass, to separate genuine code defects from any remaining concurrency artifacts
env03_test.zig's 15-allocation leak in rowToDefinitionFromFields and iss206_token_multiset_test.zig's 1-allocation leak investigated together as a possible shared root cause
onboarding_realm_guard_test.zig TC-ISS0071-01's failed-vs-completed status mismatch root-caused and fixed (highest-confidence single-file fix candidate in this batch)

Each file's disposition recorded: fixed / already-passing-in-isolation (confirms concurrency artifact, forward to ISS-0646 or its own new concurrency-tracking issue) / genuine defect requiring further design work

zig build test-integration exits 0 against a freshly migrated, workspace-owned database once all genuine defects in this list are resolved, OR any still-remaining residual is re-forwarded with the same rigor (no infinite deferral), per ISS-0645's original acceptance criteria
next_action: File as GitHub issue and add to global queue. This is deliberately a large follow-up issue preserving the full per-file evidence gathered during GH-649's triage pass -- a future WF-03 run (or several, split by the natural fault lines noted above: definition/store.zig leak; onboarding_realm_guard business logic; the shared-tenant-count-drift pair env01/spt01; the PgError.ServerError cluster needing verbose logging) should further split this before attempting fixes, per CLAUDE.md's batch-cap discipline.
